title: Forge a harness artifact
summary: Develops one governed harness artifact from a classified need, exact contract shape, adversarial evaluation, and human-reviewed change boundary.

intent.goal: Produce one target-owned harness change whose need, ownership, behavior expectations, limitations, and verification are explicit before adoption.
useWhen: A new governed pack, contract, workflow definition, rule, or host-neutral artifact is genuinely required.
excludeWhen: An existing artifact only needs a bounded edit, a decision note, or an unreviewed bulk rewrite.

procedure.outcome: Classify the requested outcome by Kernel, Core, Context, Automation, Integration, configuration, or host responsibility.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.

For every proposed new system namespace, record an explicit birth-decision disposition: link the exact optional decision when durable cross-cutting rationale warrants one, otherwise withhold it and state why the rationale belongs with the owning artifact.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never create a second source of authority for an existing responsibility.
Never treat a green schema check as behavior, readiness, verification, or health proof.
Never publish, install, realize, or merge a drafted artifact without the separate authority required for that effect.
limitations: This normalized definition preserves inspectable intent only; it has no operator runtime, provider binding, effect authority, or behavior parity.
The fingerprinted legacy source remains canonical until a separate implemented and evidenced runtime migration removes that fallback.
